# Self-Storage Chennai: Why More Households Are Choosing It Over a Bigger Home

** 11

## Chennai houses are not having space anymore and moving to bigger places is not the solution. Here is the real issue causing this and how self-storage fixes it straight away.


**[Self storage in Chennai](https://stownest.com/self-storage-chennai)** allows you to keep items outside your home. There’s no need to rent a bigger home to accommodate your belongings. This service directly resolves the space issue. With self storage, you pay only to rent the space for the items you are storing without paying for an entire extra room’s worth of rent.


---


## **What Is Self Storage, and Why Do Chennai Households Need It?**


Self storage is an opportunity to rent a safe location to hold on to personal items that don’t have a permanent location at home. In Chennai, more families are using self storage services because of a growing imbalance: homes are getting smaller with each generation and families are expanding with each generation .


Self storage is a place to keep items like furniture from past homes, heirloom items, items that are kept from previous homes, and just about everyday necessities that people want to hold on to.


---


## **Lack of Space and Getting a Larger Home Does Not Solve The Problem**


When our home becomes too small, the natural solution seems to be moving into a larger home. This however does not fix the issue. Instead makes things worse.Going to a rental house means paying for an extra room that is meant to store boxes.


We also lose our security deposit money and in addition to the poor functionality of space in the larger rental, we now have space in the rental to hold things we would prefer to forget.


Some costs are harder to see when adding a box or piece of furniture to an empty room. In a city like Chennai where growth and humidity are investments, wood and furnishings only worsen the situation with added space. A larger rental home does not solve the problem, it merely moves the problem to a different location.


---


## **How This Actually Impacts Households in Chennai**


This has two effects on families. They end up paying for space that's basically a luxury storage room, because the room is priced as a bedroom. The larger the house, the larger the room's luxury storage becomes. Families ultimately are paying extra for extra storage for things that don't get better protection. Bigger houses do not help with humidity, dust and general wear. These things still affect items that just sit around for months and even years.


For people like you and me who jump from rented flat to rented flat, the same issue manifests into paying extra rent for a bigger storage room or paying even more to jump from flat to flat with less stuff. Neither option is ideal, especially when the lack of the right space to hold your belongings is the issue.


---


## **Self Storage Solves the Actual Problem, Not a Bigger Version of It**


Self storage really is a solution to the acute storage problem because it decouples living space and storage costs. In most scenarios, you pay rent for an entire room, but with **[self storage](https://stownest.com/self-storage)** , you rent only the space your belongings actually take up. Not only do you not have to let your belongings sit in a loft or spare room where they can be exposed to the elements, sometimes even the changing elements, in self storage, but they are kept in a space designed to store belongings.


This business model gets even better with a pickup-and-delivery storage service. It solves the problem of transporting belongings to the self storage location because **[pickup-and-delivery self storage](https://stownest.com/self-storage)** means someone else does the transporting for you. The storage space is even built to allow you to see what you have stored, the system shows each individual item stored, and you simply request delivery for any of the items stored, eliminating the need to have kept a bigger house to have your belongings within easy reach.


---


## **For Whom This Solves the Problem**


This solution benefits two primary groups in Chennai. One is families who have sentimental items which get passed down but don't have the space for in modern homes. The second is for families who have to frequently rearrange their homes, especially for work, but don't want to rent a domain just for storage purposes.


---


## **Frequently Asked Questions**


**1. Why can't Chennai households just get a bigger house instead of needing self-storage?**


Self-storage saves you money. In a bigger house, you could end up paying the same rent for extra rooms that you do for totally empty space, but with self-storage, you only pay for the space that your stuff takes up.


**2. How does having a bigger house help with humidity?**


It doesn't. In Chennai, humidity will ruin your wooden, textile, or paper belongings whether you have a big house, a small house, a big loft with no humidity protection, or a big storage room with no humidity protection.


**3. Who in Chennai is self-storage most useful to?**


Families with heirlooms or other valuables families want to hold on to, but that may not fit in a smaller house, and those that move frequently for work and live in rented apartments.


**4. Does self-storage mean I have to go to the storage unit in Chennai?**


No, some companies will pick up your things from your house and take them to the storage unit for you and then do the same when you want your things back.


**5. How safe is self-storage?**


With **[StowNest](https://stownest.com/)** , safety is guaranteed and you get 24/7 coverage with a protection amount of ₹2.5 lakhs.


---


## **Chennai Homes Don't Need to Be Bigger — They Need the Right Kind of Space**


Self-storage is cheaper because customers don’t have to pay for extra space that they don’t use every day. A bigger home can solve the problem of needing[space to store belongings](https://stownest.com/) , but self-storage is a cheaper and smarter option. Homes should reflect people's needs and wants, but having a bigger home can also cater to this need.
